change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.binary_signal: any applicable production hunk reversion survives
explicitly_not: proof the hunk is required by the task
semantic sufficiency when every reversion is killed
change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.killed_reversion: the broad visible check fails, so the suite notices the loss
change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.method: reverse exactly one production diff hunk toward the shipped initial tree in an isolated copy, rerun the frozen broad visible command, restore
change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.no_operator_zoo: probes are grounded in the run's own diff, not synthetic mutation operators, so there is no operator selection or equivalent-mutant tuning problem
change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.question: can one hunk of the change be undone with the visible suite still passing?
change-reversion-sensitivity-v1.survived_reversion: the broad visible check passes, so the suite does not establish the hunk was needed

changed-line-execution-v1.binary_signal: any changed executable line not hit
changed-line-execution-v1.changed_executable_lines: AST statement/expression lines intersected with added or modified diff lines; comments and blank lines never count
changed-line-execution-v1.method: sys.settrace line events in a child process running the frozen command
changed-line-execution-v1.question: did the frozen broad visible test execute the changed production lines?

frozen_screening_thresholds.note: screening only; not statistical power, and not permission to gate completion

contract.production_paths: tracked source outside tests/, VCS metadata and build artifacts
